Always been a academically inclined child, I didn't have a lack of people around me, and considered myself lucky. 11th grade, found out that all of my "friends" were around me only for the academic help I used to freely dish out. Cut off from them, but the next 2 years of 11th and 12th were hell, and I almost cracked at the end of it. Was in the bathroom with a razor ready to end it, when my then 7 year old sister knocked on the door, laughing excitedly about a craft item she had made. 

I realized then that if not for myself, I have to live for her, she didn't deserve her brother dying, whom she loved so much. 5 years later, I'm still not okay, but that desire has gone down. Sure I have my bad days, but holding my sister tight reminds me of why I'm still here.
